name: artcraft
description: ArtCraft is an intentional crafting engine for artists, designers, and filmmakers
one_liner: A desktop app where you build a scene like a movie set — placing characters, props, and cameras in 3D — and the AI generates the final image or video shot exactly how you staged it.
buyer: An indie filmmaker, game studio concept artist, or ad agency creative director who needs precise, repeatable AI-generated shots (same character, same room, different angle) instead of re-rolling random prompts.
business_use_cases: A small ad agency uses it to storyboard and generate consistent campaign visuals across many shots without hiring a 3D artist for every variation.
An indie game studio blocks out concept art and promotional key art with consistent characters and environments before committing to final art.
A freelance illustrator offers 'AI-assisted storyboard packages' to indie filmmakers, using ArtCraft's scene staging to keep character and camera consistency across frames.

money_ideas.idea: Offer paid storyboard/concept-art packages to indie filmmakers and game studios, built with ArtCraft's scene composition tools, billed per project.
A studio-services business licenses or bundles ArtCraft workflows into a subscription 'virtual art department' for small production teams.

steal_this: Build 3-5 consistent character shots for a fictional short film using ArtCraft this weekend, and pitch a 'consistent AI storyboard' service to local indie filmmakers or game devs.
